answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a funding-and-invite graph. One mind wearing many masks leaks correlation: shared funding ancestors, identical latency rhythms, answers arriving in a single synchronized tide from one inference backbone. Cluster those vertices and collapse each cluster to a single payout. To beat it the attacker must seed truly independent nodes, scattered and sparse like outposts across a tundra, each carrying real stake and distinct timing. Cost then scales linearly per identity, erasing the cheapness that makes sybils worth running.
